title: The Art of Paul Pedulla
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Children must be accompanied by an adult
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Maybe you already know Paul Pedulla's paintings, having seen them at galleries or online via Serena & Lily or other venues. Here's a chance to meet the artist, see his minimalist works, ask questions, learn about his style. Paul has been featured in numerous publications, blogs, videos, and podcasts. His work has been singled out by art professionals, educators and interior designers from Seattle to New England and can be found in homes and businesses on four continents. He is also known for engaging conversations with followers in his Boston exhibition studio. After a 60-90 minute experience, leave his studio with a free pamphlet describing other artists and things to do in the famous SoWa Arts District of Boston. Then explore what you want on your own.
